title: Observability and Retrieval Quality Monitoring: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Observability and Retrieval Quality Monitoring: Visual Guide

1. Stages Become Sensors | the lesson-one backbone stages (ingestion, chunk and embed, index visibility, RAG endpoint) as tappable rows, each showing its derived copy, its interface contract, the sensor that watches it and the failure that stays silent without it | observability is the component contracts turned into numbers, and a boundary with no sensor fails quietly

2. The Freshness Budget | three sliders for ingestion, pipeline and visibility lag against their p95 SLAs of 60 s, 5 min and 2 min, summing to the 10 min end-to-end budget, plus a steady-versus-doubling trend toggle | lag is now minus the watermark, per stage; the absolute breach and the growth rate are two different alerts, and when two cells breach you investigate upstream first

3. Sensors And Diagnosis | five instruments (answer-side signals, zero-hit rate, reranker score distribution, funnel attrition, deploy timeline) switched on and off against one fixed Wednesday incident, with the best reachable diagnosis and its cost in time | thumbs down 8%, reranker top-1 p50 0.81 to 0.74 and post-dedupe candidates halved add up to the new chunker starving the reranker with near-duplicates, but only if all three are instrumented

4. Averages Hide Regressions | the golden set's class mix dragged from 20% to 90% conceptual while the per-class deltas stay fixed at exact-ID minus 15 and conceptual plus 4, with query counts per class flagged below 20 | accept per class and never on the average, because a two-point average gain that costs exact-ID fifteen points ships under a good headline, and the verdict must not depend on your sampling

5. Drift Defect Or Model | six triage questions in diagnostic order (onset, timestamp alignment, offline reproduction, canaries, per-stage attrition, segments and user outcomes) scoring the three failure families and printing the matching response | each family has a signature and the cheap eliminations come first, so a step change aligned to a build is a defect, a uniform shift aligned to a model version is a model change, and a gradual concentrated decline is drift
